results.title: the part's own code raises an unexpected Python exception
results.happened: BackupManager.backup raises RuntimeError: The book finished with nothing lost.

finding.cause: `try_backup` is best effort and returns None on any error; `_s_backup` only writes the step line “Backup could not be written (continuing; see Health)” and carries on. No journal code, no warning on the finished run, nothing in “Needs a look”; only the separate ❤️ Health page turns amber (“The last automatic backup failed”). Here the backup code itself raised (any exception is swallowed the same way).
finding.fix: Add a coded journal note (e.g. BACKUP_FAILED) and keep a warning on the finished run / “Needs a look” (“This book was made without a safety backup — free some disk space and press 💾 Back up now”).
finding.what: A broken backup is swallowed: the whole book is made without a safety backup and the finished run does not say so

finding.where: akowe/akowe/assist.py `AssistService._call_ai_once` (lines ~700-735): the call is made with an explicit `slot_id` and only UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE / AI_DECLINED move to another AI; akowe/akowe/providers.py `AutoInjectorAdapter.submit` (line ~1073) raises INTERNAL_ERROR with `try_other_ai` after the re-asks; akowe/akowe/autobook.py `_ai_problem` (line ~2741)

finding.cause: The PDF fonts (WinAnsi + bundled DejaVu Serif) cannot print Arabic (or Hebrew, CJK, emoji). The title is printed in the book, so G05 refuses the whole book at “Put the book together”. After the author renamed the book to a Latin title, Resume stopped again with INVALID_INPUT “Approve every chapter and the book format first.” (the run cannot finish at all; see Section F).
finding.fix: In `_s_profile` check the title with `exporters.unifont.uncovered` and ask the AI for a title the book's fonts can print (or keep a Latin title plus the original in the profile); at G05 say which characters cannot be printed and where (“the title”), category “book”, not “AI”.
finding.what: A non-Latin (Arabic) title or an emoji in the AI's title stops the book at assembly with “G05 could not be created (BLOCKED)”, called an AI problem; Try again and even renaming the book cannot finish it
